title: Tradescantia ‘Silver Smudge’ – 2x Plug Plant - Easy Care Plugplant
description:
Tradescantia ‘Silver Smudge’ – 1x Plug Plant
 

 You will receive one healthy
 
  plug plant
 
 of
 
  Tradescantia ‘Silver Smudge’
 
 , ready to pot up and grow on at home. This variety is easy to care for and suitable for both beginners and experienced plant growers.


  Plant Description:
 

 Tradescantia ‘Silver Smudge’ displays striped foliage with shades of green and silver. The colour and appearance of the leaves can vary depending on light levels, watering, and seasonal changes. This plant is suitable for use as a trailing or hanging indoor plant.


  Growth Characteristics:
 

  Stems are smooth and hairless, up to approximately 7 mm wide.
 

  Internodes range from 1.5 cm to 8 cm in length.
 

  Colour tones can vary from yellow-green to dark red or greyish purple, with lighter green freckles.
 

  Additional Information:
 

 The plant shown in photographs represents our parent stock, which originated from a specialist grower. The images illustrate how the mature plant will look once established.


 Tradescantia, commonly known as Wandering Dude, belongs to the Spiderwort family. It is known for its ability to root easily and adapt to a variety of indoor environments.
